card_comparison: The deterministic extraction contains twenty top-level sample problems, numbered I through XX. They are represented in source order by P-MTH674-01 through P-MTH674-20; the worked solution following Problem VII(c) remains source material rather than a second problem card.
known_extractor_repairs: Problem V(c) prints z^1 in the equation immediately identified as the three-dimensional unit sphere in R^4; the card restores z^2 from that deterministic local context.
Dropped map arrows in Problems VI(b), VII(c), XIII(a), XV(d), XVIII(a), and XIX are restored from their displayed source and target objects.
Problem VIII(b) renders the exponent in (x^1)^2 as a malformed hat-2 token; the card restores the exponent 2 from the displayed transition-function pair.
Problem XII(e) has a mangled matrix display; the card preserves the stated (n-2)-by-2 size and reconstructs the 2-by-2 n=4 example from the two displayed basis vectors.
Problem XVI(b) mangles the bracket around the two hatted vector fields; the card restores the Lie bracket notation from the immediately stated F-relatedness claim.
